title: feat: ingestion pause/resume and max-chunk guard (rebased on upstream)
body: ## Description Ingestion pause/resume + hardened chunk guard on upstream-aligned `main`. ## Changes Made - Pause/resume API + cooperative pipeline hooks - Chunk progress tracking (WebUI + shared storage) - **Chunk guard hardening:** estimates use resolved `TextChunkingConfig`, strategy multipliers, delimiter-aware fixed-token math; `/documents/texts` now enforces the guard - Pipeline pause tests (`tests/pipeline/test_pipeline_pause.py`) ## Testing - `pytest tests/test_ingestion_controls.py tests/pipeline/test_pipeline_pause.py` — 14 passed - `ruff check` on touched files ## Follow-ups - WebUI pause/resume + large-ingest confirm dialog - Demote `INGESTION_JOB_REGISTRY` for multi-worker Gunicorn
